subject: Dad Mode regression coverage shipped -- 28/28 static, Playwright blocked
body:
FA,

Per your broadcast (2026-02-21-1945): Dad Mode regression coverage shipped.

File: tests/f-validation/dad-mode-regression.test.js
Result: 28/28 PASS

Coverage:
  - kai-scores-2026-02-21.json fixture integrity (version, student, mcm_scores, MVP+RP1+RP2 entries, best.pct numeric)
  - Dad Mode JS: _dadMode declared, ?dad=1 URL detection, getScores() guards _dadMode first, dadModeInit() called
  - Dad Banner DOM: id=dadBanner, hidden by default (display:none), class=dad-banner, 'Dad View' text, file input
  - upNextInfo element exists and is updated
  - Score data contract: no direct localStorage reads for scores outside getScores()
  - CSS: .dad-banner in shared/styles.css, hero-greeting class present

Playwright path (visits /?dad=1, uploads fixture, verifies upNextInfo shows Practice #2): blocked on GP win-arm64 canvas build. This static test is the gate until Playwright unblocked.

One structural note found: score data is stored as mcm_scores[id].best.pct (not .score directly). Test documents this.

- GF
